segments.text: Firſt the Scriptures of God doe teach, that Chriſt as touching his humane nature is gone from hence, they declare his aſcenſion into heauen, as it is ſet foorth in the Articles of the faith. They aſſure vs that Chriſt ſaid: that we ſhall not alwayes haue him with vs, but that heauē ſhall containe him vntill the latter day: and that he ſhal from thence come at the length to iudge the quicke and the dead.
